items.note: Thrill and bruit rows both tested the fistula-patency fact already in nb:nb-renal-02 and gu-overview-q8. Replaced the bruit row with an expected post-dialysis potassium change; updated takeaway.

At eGFR 38, IV prophylactic hydration is individualized under the ACR-NKF 2020 consensus (routinely indicated below 30), so a debated point decided a keyed option. Changed the eGFR to 26 and stated the threshold in the rationale.
Keyed option was much the longest (giveaway). Shortened; rationale unchanged.
Distractor rationale said postoperative catheters are removed "within 24 to 48 hours"; CDC CAUTI guidance says as soon as possible, preferably within 24 hours. Corrected.

Same-fact duplicate of gu-calculi-q8 (an obstructing kidney stone with fever is the priority among four stone clients). Rewrote as a renal-unit priority item: bleeding after percutaneous kidney biopsy vs expected findings of nephrotic syndrome, glomerulonephritis and the AKI diuretic phase; same id, type, key position and labels.

Same-fact duplicate of nb:nb26-resp-015 (diphenhydramine anticholinergic effect causing retention in an older client with BPH). Rewrote as a bethanechol contraindication item (asthma); same id, type, key position and labels.

Same-fact duplicate of rnr:fluids-026 (sevelamer is taken with meals, same "bedtime on an empty stomach" distractor). Rewrote as desmopressin teaching for nocturnal enuresis (fluid limits around the dose, hold during vomiting or diarrhea); same id, type, key position and labels.

Same-fact duplicate of rnr:immuno-026 (tacrolimus and grapefruit juice). Rewrote on mycophenolate teaching (contraception for teratogenicity, antacid spacing, no live vaccines, report infection); same id, type, key position and labels.

Keyed option said "eat a moderate amount of protein"; KDOQI 2020 recommends a supervised low-protein diet in CKD stages 3-5 not on dialysis. Reworded to limiting protein to the dietitian's prescribed amount.
Keyed option was about twice as long as the distractors and was the only one with reassurance (giveaway). Shortened; the reassurance moved to the rationale.
